Hand-written walkthroughs, reference tables, and strategy pages, as opposed to the item, character, and ability pages generated from extracted game data.

A page belongs here when a person wrote it to explain how to do something: a walkthrough, a progression or gearing guide, a class or role breakdown, or an explanation of a game system that needs more than an infobox.

Overview pages that are mostly generated tables, such as [[Armor]] and [[Weapons]], do not belong here. Neither do individual [[Zones|zone]], [[:Category:Characters|character]], or item pages.
